questions.question: What is the type of Int("12")?
questions.why: Not all text is a number, so the conversion gives an optional.

questions.question: What does nickname ?? "friend" give when nickname is nil?
questions.why: ?? falls back to the value on its right when the left side is nil.

questions.question: What is name?.count when name is "Ana"?
questions.why: Optional chaining always produces an optional, even when there is a value.

questions.question: When should you choose guard let over if let?

answers.text: When the function cannot do its main job without the value

questions.why: guard let leaves early and keeps the unwrapped value for the rest of the function.

questions.question: What happens when you force unwrap nil with !?
questions.why: ! promises a value is there. If it is not, Swift stops the program.
